item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 02/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather to the coastal areas of southern China persistently in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the inland areas of southern China over the weekend. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week, bringing relatively dry weather to the region midweek next week.
